name: CloberDEX
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to _burn, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step DeFi interaction involving a flash loan, creation of a malicious WETH/fake-token pool, minting LP against a fake asset, and a reentrant burn via hook logic to drain WETH. While the bug class is understandable once identified, writing the PoC requires protocol-specific understanding of the rebalancer/book manager and hook-based reentrancy flow, putting it beyond a simple one-step exploit.
